lead.headline: Monangai scored 28 on your bench, then hurt his thumb
lead.deck: You lead 97.6 to 80.2 and ESPN gives you 24%: Aye-Aye have St. Brown and McMillan tonight, you have Kamara on Monday. Nothing left to set.
lead.body: The points were on the roster and not in the lineup. Kyle Monangai, benched at a projection of 8.3, carried 30 times for 146 yards and two touchdowns against the Jets and scored 28.0, then left late with a thumb injury that the Bears are still evaluating. Ollie Gordon had 18.0 on the bench with Miami still playing. The projection chose Bhayshul Tuten, who had two touchdowns called back and finished on 11.1, and no brief overrode it, so there is no new rule to draw, only a result to record. Garrett Wilson was healthy and caught three passes for 5.7 in a game the Jets threw 15 times. On the other side Isaiah Likely drew 12 targets for 13.6, Josh Allen scored 18.5, and Ka'imi Fairbairn, whom you added this morning against the brief's advice to hold, kicked three long field goals for 16. You lead 97.6 to 80.2, and ESPN still expects you to lose, 109 to 125: Aye-Aye have Amon-Ra St. Brown and Tetairoa McMillan tonight in Carolina and you have only Alvin Kamara on Monday. For next week, Justin Jefferson is reported hopeful, Terry McLaurin has no timeline, and Jalen Coker, unlikely to play tonight, is on bye. Tuesday's claim for DK Metcalf still stands. Its drop, which was Monangai, does not.
